info.name: eCFR API Documentation Admin Service Search Service API

params.name: query
params.description: Search term; searches the headings and the full text

params.name: agency_slugs[]
params.description: limit to content currently associated with these agencies (see AdminService agencies endpoint to retrieve a list of agency slugs)

params.name: date
params.description: limit to content present on this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: last_modified_after
params.description: limit to content last modified after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: last_modified_on_or_after
params.description: limit to content last modified on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: last_modified_before
params.description: limit to content last modified before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: last_modified_on_or_before
params.description: limit to content last modified on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

params.name: per_page
params.description: number of results per page; max of 1,000

params.name: page
params.description: page of results; can't paginate beyond 10,000 total results

params.name: order
params.description: order of results

params.name: paginate_by
params.description: how results should be paginated - 'date' will group results so that all results from a date appear on the same page of pagination. If 'date' is chosen then one of the last_modified_* options is required.
